message.content: {"caption":"Grouped bar chart comparing PPO and GRPO scores across three metrics for four Memory-R1 configurations.","description":"Four side-by-side grouped-bar panels show Score (vertical axis, labeled ticks from 20 to 60; the axis begins at 20) for F1, B1, and J (horizontal axis). In each panel, PPO is pink and GRPO is teal, as shown in the legend. Panel a, “w/o Memory-R1 Memory Manager,” shows PPO/GRPO scores of 34.5/37.5 for F1, 28.1/30.6 for B1, and 49.0/52.9 for J. Panel b, “w/o Memory-R1 Answer Agent,” shows 32.5/33.0 for F1, 24.6/24.9 for B1, and 59.4/59.9 for J. Panel c, “w/o Memory Distillation,” shows 39.3/41.0 for F1, 30.9/34.4 for B1, and 57.4/60.1 for J. Panel d, “Full Memory-R1 Pipeline,” shows 41.0/45.0 for F1, 32.9/37.5 for B1, and 57.5/62.7 for J. Values are printed above the bars. GRPO is higher than PPO for every metric in every panel. J is the highest-scoring category in panels a, b, and c; in panel d, J is highest for both series, with F1 above B1 throughout. Gray dashed horizontal reference marks indicate the baseline pipeline without RL fine-tuning; they have no printed numeric labels.
